rationale: All 4 fix-set blocking findings resolved: onSessionEnd split via processLocatedTranscripts, locateTranscript windows on first-event time, AC4 test uses distinct transcripts, commit subjects carry no ticket key (Refs footer). Advisory CR-005/CR-006 were not in the fix set.

findings.title: onSessionEnd exceeds 50-line function limit
findings.problem: code-quality.md requires functions under 50 lines; onSessionEnd is about 65 lines and does id resolution, transcript location, processing and SessionEnd dispatch.
findings.impact: Documented code-quality rule is incompletely met and the function is harder to test and change.
findings.recommendation: Extract the transcript processing loop and the SessionEnd dispatch into helper functions.
findings.check_notes: Loop extracted to processLocatedTranscripts; onSessionEnd shrinks by ~28 lines

findings.title: Run window filters on mtime, not start time
findings.problem: locateTranscript filters on file mtimeMs, but the spec says birth/first-event time. A transcript begun before the run (a resumed session) and touched during it is included, so its earlier lines are counted into this run. One begun in-run but last written after the next record's start is dropped. A second unclaimed Claude session in the same cwd inside the window is also attributed to this record.
findings.impact: Line metrics are over-counted or misattributed, or missed. Trigger: resumed session, or concurrent claude in the same cwd. Confirmed by reading the filter at lines 159-165.
findings.recommendation: Window by birth/first-event time as the spec states, and skip lines older than record.startTime when processing. Optionally check the first-line cwd/sessionId.
findings.check_notes: transcriptStartTime reads first-event timestamp, falls back to mtime; new windowing test added

fix.change: locateTranscript windows by first-event timestamp (mtime fallback)

findings.title: Two-transcript test cannot fail on single-file loop
findings.problem: The two-transcript lifecycle test (AC4) copies one fixture twice, so dedupe by recordId yields 7/2 even if only one file is processed.
findings.impact: AC4 summing across transcripts is not demonstrated by the test, so a regression in the processing loop would go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Use two distinct transcripts, as the spike test does, and assert the summed totals.
findings.check_notes: Second transcript is a distinct rewritten copy; totals asserted 14/4

fix.change: Two-transcript test uses distinct transcripts, asserts 14/4

findings.title: Ticket key in all commit subjects
findings.problem: All 6 commit subjects in the range embed EPMCDME-14384; git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says to put the ticket in the body footer when scope conveys context.
findings.impact: Documented commit-format rule is broken across the range and blocks the workflow.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subjects without the ticket key and put the reference in the body footer. With Squash-and-Merge, keep the key out of the PR title.
findings.check_notes: git log shows all 6 subjects without ticket key and Refs: EPMCDME-14384 in body

findings.title: Long cwd encoding may not match Claude's
findings.problem: encodeClaudeProjectDir does not truncate and hash-suffix very long paths the way Claude Code may.
findings.impact: Only for a cwd over about 200 characters; locateTranscript returns [] and no metrics are recorded. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Verify Claude Code's long-path behavior and mirror it if it exists.

findings.title: Stale active record skips SessionStart
findings.problem: A leftover active record with the same id and no endTime, for example after a crash, makes onSessionStart skip.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: a crashed earlier run with the same id. The old startTime widens the window. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Also check process liveness or a heartbeat before skipping.
